review: 701.37b: triage marked it definitional, but the designation persisting on the battlefield and resetting when the permanent leaves is observable; reclassified as mechanical and added scenario 701.37b-1 (Cloudshift on a monstrous Fleecemane Lion, then monstrosity again).

scenarios.title: Monstrosity 1 puts a +1/+1 counter on a non-monstrous permanent and does nothing to a monstrous one

setup.notes: Fleecemane Lion is not monstrous and has no counters. Both libraries are non-empty and irrelevant.

decisions: A activates Fleecemane Lion's monstrosity ability ({3}{G}{W}), tapping all five lands.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.
Both players pass with the stack empty.

variants.label: not_monstrous
variants.expected: The ability resolves: Fleecemane Lion gets one +1/+1 counter and is monstrous, so it is a 4/4 with hexproof and indestructible.

variants.label: already_monstrous
variants.delta: Fleecemane Lion is already monstrous and carries one +1/+1 counter from an earlier activation.
variants.expected: The ability resolves but puts no counter: Fleecemane Lion still has exactly one +1/+1 counter and is a 4/4 with hexproof and indestructible.

scenarios.forge_notes: The monstrous designation is not a setup field. For the already_monstrous variant the Lion must be set up (or played up) as having become monstrous earlier, for example by a first activation resolved before the scenario's decisions.

scenarios.title: Monstrosity N puts N counters, not one

setup.notes: Hundred-Handed One is not monstrous and has no counters. Both libraries are non-empty and irrelevant. The monstrosity activation costs {3}{W}{W}{W}, paid with six Plains.

decisions: A activates Hundred-Handed One's monstrosity ability ({3}{W}{W}{W}), tapping all six Plains.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.
Both players pass with the stack empty.

variants.label: not_monstrous
variants.expected: Hundred-Handed One gets three +1/+1 counters and is monstrous: it is a 6/8 with vigilance and reach.

variants.label: already_monstrous
variants.delta: Hundred-Handed One is already monstrous and carries three +1/+1 counters from an earlier activation.
variants.expected: The ability resolves but puts no counters: Hundred-Handed One still has exactly three +1/+1 counters and is a 6/8 with vigilance and reach.

scenarios.forge_notes: The monstrous designation is not a setup field; the already_monstrous variant needs a Hundred-Handed One that became monstrous earlier.

scenarios.title: A permanent's other ability uses the X value it became monstrous with

setup.notes: Polukranos, World Eater is not monstrous and has no counters. Both libraries are non-empty and irrelevant.

decisions: A activates Polukranos's monstrosity ability with X = 2 ({X}{X}{G}), tapping all five Forests.
Both players pass; the ability resolves, Polukranos becomes monstrous, and its becomes-monstrous trigger goes on the stack.
A targets Grizzly Bears with the trigger and assigns all of the damage to it.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves.
Both players pass with the stack empty.

variants.label: x2
variants.expected: Polukranos gets two +1/+1 counters and is monstrous (7/7). The trigger deals 2 damage to Grizzly Bears, which moves to B's graveyard in the state-based check. Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage to Polukranos, which stays on the battlefield with 2 damage marked.

variants.label: x1
variants.delta: A activates the ability with X = 1 ({X}{X}{G}, tapping three Forests) instead of X = 2.
variants.expected: Polukranos gets one +1/+1 counter and is monstrous (6/6). The trigger deals 1 damage to Grizzly Bears, which stays on the battlefield with 1 damage marked. Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage to Polukranos, which stays on the battlefield with 2 damage marked.

variants.label: already_monstrous
variants.delta: Polukranos is already monstrous and carries one +1/+1 counter from an earlier activation.
variants.expected: The ability resolves but Polukranos does not become monstrous again: it keeps exactly one +1/+1 counter (6/6), the becomes-monstrous trigger does not fire, and Grizzly Bears takes no damage and stays on the battlefield.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge reads X for the trigger through the TriggerCount$Amount SVar on the BecomeMonstrous trigger. In the already_monstrous variant Polukranos must have become monstrous earlier.

scenarios.title: A monstrous permanent that leaves and returns is no longer monstrous

setup.notes: Fleecemane Lion is already monstrous and carries one +1/+1 counter from an earlier activation. Both libraries are non-empty and irrelevant.

decisions: A casts Cloudshift targeting Fleecemane Lion, tapping a Plains.
A activates Fleecemane Lion's monstrosity ability ({3}{G}{W}), tapping three Forests and two Plains.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.
Both players pass with the stack empty.

variants.label: flickered
variants.expected: Fleecemane Lion is exiled and returns as a 3/3 with no counters, not monstrous and without hexproof or indestructible; the monstrosity ability then puts one +1/+1 counter on it and it is a monstrous 4/4 with hexproof and indestructible. Cloudshift is in A's graveyard.

variants.label: not_flickered
variants.delta: A does not cast Cloudshift; Cloudshift stays in A's hand.
variants.expected: Fleecemane Lion stays monstrous; the monstrosity ability resolves but puts no counter, and Fleecemane Lion still has exactly one +1/+1 counter and is a 4/4 with hexproof and indestructible.

scenarios.forge_notes: The monstrous designation is not a setup field; the Lion must have become monstrous earlier, for example by a first activation resolved before the scenario's decisions.
